title: THE CROWN DAM
notes: Painted scenery (revision 3, step D): the 5 st8 paintings (work/bg/gen/st8 -> strips tools/art/strips/st8, prompts tools/art/bg-prompts.json; st8 has no a0-2). a0 is the turbine gallery (one painting, 1312 px); a1 and a2 are the four strips of their two paintings in storyline order (a<N>-1 A, B, a<N>-2 A, B), overlapping 32 px with a floor-only crossfade (2592 px).

Gameplay structure (sections, lock counts, task props, casts, boss lock) from step B, re-fitted to the painted areas and their floor lines. a0 is one painting, so 8-1 and 8-2 share it (672 + 640 px); a1 is the lifts and platform (8-3) and the gatehouse with the lift gear (8-4); a2 is the gate control room and the blast doors (8-5) and the dam crest (8-6, the boss arena at the spillway gantry).
